csv_project_name: AE for Mt. Werner Road & Mt. Werner Circle Roundabout
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Steamboat Springs (the City ), acting as the administrative agent for the Steamboat Springs Redevelopment Authority (the SSRA ), seeks to contract with a qualified, professional civil engineering firm with demonstrated expertise in modern roundabout planning and design ( Consultant ) pursuant to this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) to produce design documents and provide engineering services during construction for a new roundabout and associated Complete Streets improvements at the intersection of Mt. Werner Road and Mt. Werner Circle in Steamboat Springs, Colorado (the Project ). The Project will be pursued with funding from the SSRA. There currently is no outside funding from granting agencies or private sources. The Project consists of the following key improvements: A single-lane modified roundabout with potential bypass lanes at the three-leg intersection of Mt. Werner Road and Mt. Werner Circle, validated against current and 20-year design-horizon traffic forecasts; A new sidewalk for Complete Streets Segments 3B and 4A, connecting the existing sidewalk on the north side of the intersection of Mt. Werner Road and Steamboat Boulevard east along Mt. Werner Road and Mt. Werner Circle to the intersection with Burgess Creek Road; Complete Streets improvements including pedestrian connections, bicycle facilities, basic and enhanced landscaping treatments (plantings, fencing, decorative rocks, etc), lighting and wayfinding signage; Standard storm drainage improvements and permanent water quality infrastructure associated with the civil improvements; Street signage and striping.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Testing, Analytical/Testing Services, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering, Water Quality Testing, Traffic Design Engineering, Graphic Design/Public Art
